Title: Check the Light, Dark and System buttons are visible on the login page
Expected Result: The Light, Dark and System buttons are visible.

Title: Open the login page for the first time and check Light is selected with a light background
Preconditions: Browser has no saved theme. Computer theme is light
Expected Result: The Light button is selected. The page background is light (rgb(246, 247, 250)).

Title: Click Dark on the login page and check the page turns dark
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Click Dark.
Expected Result: The Dark button is selected. The page background is dark (rgb(10, 12, 16)).

Title: Click Dark, then click Light and check the page turns light again
Expected Result: The Light button is selected. The page background is light again.

Title: Click System while the computer theme is light and check the page is light
Expected Result: The System button is selected. The page background is light.

Title: Click System while the computer theme is dark and check the page is dark
Expected Result: The System button is selected. The page background is dark.

Title: Select System, then change the computer theme from light to dark and check the page turns dark without reload
Steps: 1. Click System. 2. Change the computer theme to dark.
Expected Result: The page turns dark by itself. The System button stays selected.

Title: Click Dark, reload the page and check the page is still dark with Dark selected
Expected Result: The page is still dark. The Dark button is still selected.

Title: Click Dark and check the browser saves the choice as "dark"
Click System, reload the page and check System is still selected
Expected Result: The System button is still selected.

Title: Click Dark on the login page, then login with valid email and valid password and check the workspace page is dark
Steps: 1. Click Dark. 2. Login with the valid email and password.
Expected Result: The workspace page opens in dark. The Dark button is selected.

Title: Check the Light, Dark and System buttons are visible on the workspace page
Expected Result: The Light, Dark and System buttons are visible.

Title: Click Dark on the workspace page and check the page turns dark
Steps: 1. Open the workspace page. 2. Click Dark.
Expected Result: The Dark button is selected. The page background is dark.

Title: Click Dark on the workspace page, open /my-work and check it is still dark
Steps: 1. Click Dark. 2. Open the "Your work" page.
Expected Result: The "Your work" page is dark. The Dark button is selected.

Title: Click Dark, Light and System one by one on the workspace page and check only one button is selected each time
Steps: 1. Click Dark. 2. Click Light. 3. Click System.
Expected Result: After each click only the clicked button is selected. The other two are not.

Title: Save the unknown theme value "blue" in the browser, open the login page and check the page still loads with a valid theme
Expected Result: The page loads without a problem. The background is either light or dark.
